Attached: 1 image

Technical one for the CrewAI builders: your crew can answer the phone.
1. POST /v1/numbers on CallNode → a live US/CA number in seconds
2. call.answered fires a webhook → kick off your crew
3. transcript.turn streams each caller utterance; the agent's reply plays back as speech
The crew reasons, CallNode carries the voice. No SIP, no telephony code.
#AIAgents #VoiceAI
